title: Autumnal Apple Galette with Honey Glaze
description: A delicious and elegant dessert featuring a flaky pastry crust, tender apples, and a sweet honey glaze.
instructions: Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced apples, granulated sugar, and honey.
Arrange the apple mixture in a spiral pattern, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the apples, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the egg wash over the dough to give it a golden brown color.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
While the galette is baking, prepare the honey glaze by whisking together the honey and 1 tablespoon of water.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the honey glaze over the galette and serve warm.
